narrative.benchmark_md:
OneAZ is benchmarked against five peer credit unions selected for sub-vertical match, asset size proximity ($1.3B-$5.3B), and Arizona/Western US geographic relevance: Connexus Credit Union (WI, $4.1B), Bellco Credit Union (CO, $5.3B), Patelco Credit Union (CA, $9.5B), Vantage West Credit Union (AZ, $2.3B), and TruWest Credit Union (AZ, $1.3B). Connexus leads the cohort (3.22 avg) with digital-first positioning, while TruWest (2.31) provides a baseline comparator. Notably, Patelco experienced a ransomware breach in 2024 (E-peer data), highlighting the cybersecurity risks facing the peer group.
Key peer insights: OneAZ leads peers in Governance (+0.64 vs median) and Process Optimization (+0.46), reflecting strong institutional foundations. The largest gaps are in Analytics (-1.41), Personalization (-1.32), and Security (-0.98). The entire cohort scores weakly on ESG (median 2.55), indicating this is an industry-wide development area rather than an OneAZ-specific deficiency.

Next is Generative AI Strategy & Use Cases at 1.7/5 against a 3.1 peer median [E-010, E-017]. Third is Fine-Grained Entitlement Design at 1.8/5 against a 2.8 peer median [E-043, E-076].
